messages:
maria: FYI — overnight perf CI flagged a p95 regression (~+18%) for small-batch (batch_size=8k tokens) on runtime-e2. failing job: ci-nightly/runtime-perf-616000. logs/artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/6160000420/perf.zip :eyes:

ci-bot: job ci-nightly/runtime-perf-616000 failed 3:14AM UTC — summary attached

hao: any idea which change could cause this? last green 6160000100

maria: looks correlated with the KV cache eviction tweak in #4521 (merged in 6160000155). commit 7f3b2d1. i pulled a sample flame from the artifact, see trace in perf.zip -> traces/trace-7f3b2d1.html

anika: can you repro locally with a focused load? try this quick repro (smallbatch):
```
scripts/run_local_bench.sh --model llama2-7b --profile --batch-size 8 --tokens-per-request 1000 --seed 42
```
also try with `--kv-cache-size=0.8` vs `1.0` to see evictions

keith: if it's KV eviction, that would explain p95. we should capture a lightweight heap+alloc profile during a short run:
```
./tools/collect_profile --target runtime-e2 --duration 60 --out /tmp/prof-$(date +%s).tgz
```
post the .tgz to the artifact bucket.

maria: thanks — i'll run the repro now and attach results. pinging @hao to watch infra quotas in case we need extra capacity. :phone:

hao: watching. i can repro the delta locally, running the script now. will upload results to the job link.

(10m later)

hao: quick upload: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/6160000420/repros/hao-local.tar.gz — p95 about +16% with kv-cache-size=0.8

anika: that's strong signal. i'd prefer we temporarily revert the KV eviction threshold change and re-run nightly to confirm.

keith: i'll open a rollback PR against infra-configs in a minute, tag `hotfix/kv-evict-rollback`. will also add a canary rollout to 5%.

maria: approved. please reference this thread in the PR. i'll coordinate the nightly rerun and collect new traces. once we confirm, we schedule postmortem in eng-runtime channel.

keith: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/configs/pulls/789 — note: will not touch serving runtime code, only config.

deploy-bot: canary rollout queued for cluster runtime-e2-alpha at 03:40AM UTC

maria: awesome. assigning follow-ups: @keith handle PR & canary, @hao collect the new perf profile after rollout, @anika run post-rollback local repro. i'll file the incident note.

hao: on it. :+1:

anika: copying the repro commands into the runbook at https://docs.redwood.dev/runbooks/runtime/kv-evict-rollback

maria: thanks team. will update here after the canary results. :tada:
